biggest_catch: Both you and your friend only get paid after the friend opens a new membership, deposits $100+ within 30 days (or funds a $10,000+ vehicle loan), and the reward is a gift card - not cash - with a $500/year cap per referrer.
catches: Referrer must be 18+, a US legal resident, and an existing Vantage member; employees may not be the referrer on an account they open.
Friend must be eligible for membership, not an existing member, and not have been a member at any time in the preceding 12 months.

Friend must open a new membership account with the $5 minimum deposit using the email address submitted to the program, then within 30 days either deposit $100+ (cash/check/ACH/wire/payroll) or fund a vehicle loan of at least $10,000.
Referrer must be the first person to have referred the friend; rewards capped at $500 per calendar year.
Reward is a gift card ($50 for the account route, $100 for the auto-loan route) - terms state gift cards cannot be redeemed for cash unless otherwise stated.
Referrer is solely responsible for federal/state/local taxes on rewards.

If your referral meets all of the conditions in Sections 3 and 4 and your Friend opens a new membership and funds a loan as described in Section 3(d.2), you will receive a $100 gift card and your Friend will receive a $100 gift card.'

steps: Visit the Vantage refer-a-friend page and enter your email to get your personalized share link.
Share the link with friends, family, or colleagues by email or social media.
Friend opens a new Vantage membership using the submitted email address and deposits $100+ within 30 days (or funds a $10,000+ vehicle loan within 30 days).
You receive a $50 gift card ($100 for the auto-loan route) after eligibility verification.
timing: Reward issued after the referred friend meets all conditions and eligibility is verified; no exact payout window stated.
